name: Bharat Dynamics Ltd.
business_summary: Government-owned (74.9%) maker of guided missiles and allied systems (Akash, Astra, Invar, Konkan/Milan, torpedoes and counter-measures), almost entirely for the Indian MoD. Revenue is lumpy and dependent on delivery milestones; FY26 sales Rs2,442 cr (-19%), TTM Rs2,766 cr, TTM EBITDA Rs352 cr (13%) and other income Rs440 cr (treasury) lift PAT to Rs521 cr. Order book Rs26,176 cr at Q1 FY27. Market cap Rs39,299 cr at 75x P/E; debt-free; stock -27% over 12 months and at a 52-week low (2026-10-28). Q1 FY27 sales Rs572 cr, PAT Rs119 cr.

revenue_mix.segment: missiles and weapon systems (Akash, Astra, Invar, torpedoes)

exposures.mechanism: Single-customer (MoD) guided-missile maker; order book Rs26,176 cr at Q1 FY27 vs TTM sales Rs2,766 cr (~9.5 years of revenue; NiftyTrader 2026-08-14). +10% domestic orders => ~+10% revenue after 2-3 years, op. leverage ~1.5x => EBITDA +15%; x EV/MCap ~0.85 (large cash) x persistence 0.5 => ~+6; shaded to 5.0 for timing slippage. DAC cleared Rs2.12 lakh cr proposals on 2026-10-26/27 and BDL gained up to 5%.

evidence.note: ET/Business Today: BEML, BDL, HAL, BEL, MTAR rise up to 5% after DAC clears Rs2.12 lakh crore

exposures.mechanism: Akash, Astra, Invar and torpedoes pursue export orders (Armenia, SE Asia); BDL exports small today but any large export win re-rates a Rs2,766 cr-sales company. Judgemental.

Escalation accelerates missile replenishment orders and emergency procurement (precedent: May 2025 defence rally, model knowledge); beta 1.6-1.7 amplifies sentiment. +1 = escalation => ~+3 sentiment-led, mostly short-lived.
Defence capital outlay is part of central capex; budgetary allocation underpins DAC approvals. Shaded because P_DEFENCE_PROCUREMENT already carries the direct effect.

Two opposing channels: treasury income (other income Rs440 cr TTM vs EBITDA Rs352 cr; +25bp on ~Rs 7,500 cr deposits (assumed) = ~Rs19 cr = +2.6% PBT x0.5 persistence => ~+1.1) versus discount-rate duration on a 75x P/E stock (~-1.7). Net slightly negative.

evidence.note: Google News: Reuters 2026-10-07 'India first hike in nearly 4 years'; SCC Online 'repo to 5.50%, calibrated tightening'

exposures.mechanism: Imported components/licence content (Invar from Russia, French/Israeli electronics; ~25% import content, model knowledge) but MoD contracts often carry FERV clauses; net small negative. Empirical -2.93 (t=-1.1) is larger but noisy.
Invar anti-tank missile built under Russian licence (model knowledge); sanctions or payment problems can disrupt kits and spares. Probability-weighted small negative.
Seekers and guidance electronics depend on imported chips; tightening delays deliveries (execution already lumpy: Q1 FY27 sales Rs572 cr vs Q2 FY26 Rs1,147 cr).
Market beta ~1.6-1.7, 1y volatility 39%, stock at 52-week low (-27% over 12m); +5 VIX hits high-beta PSU defence names harder. Empirical +0.63 (t=0.8) has opposite sign, treated as noise.

Fundamentally a small cost item (airframe materials ~2-3% of costs) but empirical sensitivity is positive (+1.59, t=1.0); cost-plus MoD contracts pass costs through, so the net is near zero. Shaded to +0.3 on the data.
